setup.title: Set up Overlook
setup.intro: Overlook has no config yet. Pick the tools your homelab runs, try each one, then save the two files this page puts together.
setup.group.checkengines_ask: Start with one. Problems come only from a check engine, which runs your checks and sends your alerts: without one, the page can't say what's wrong.
setup.same_name: Another source is named {name}: give each a name
setup.why.certificate: Its certificate is signed by a CA Overlook doesn't trust. Copy that CA into the config folder and give its path as CA file: its README section says which file it is.
setup.why.certificate_none: Its certificate is signed by a CA Overlook doesn't trust. Give its http:// address, or give it a certificate the system trusts.
setup.why.certificate_name: Its certificate is for another name. Give that name as Certificate's name, or reach it by that name.
setup.why.certificate_name_none: Its certificate is for another name: reach it by that name.
setup.why.plain: It answers over plain HTTP: give its address with http://.
setup.why.refused: Nothing answers at that address and port.
setup.why.localhost: If Overlook runs in a container, {host} is the container itself: give the address of the machine {name} runs on.
setup.why.no_host: Overlook can't find a machine by that name.
setup.why.local: Overlook can't look up .local names: give the address of the machine {name} runs on.
setup.why.timeout: No answer within 10 seconds: is {name} on a network Overlook can reach?
setup.why.key: {name} refused the key or login. Its README section says which to make.
setup.why.not_found: Something answers there, but not {name}: check the port, and the path if it's under one.
setup.answered_empty: Answered, but has nothing to show yet
setup.selected: Selected: copy it with ⌘C or Ctrl+C
setup.env_note: The keys overlook.yaml names. Keep this file out of git.
setup.restart: Save both files in the folder mounted at /etc/overlook, named overlook.yaml and .env, then restart Overlook, such as with docker compose restart. Once Overlook is back, this page turns into the page.
setup.restart_unraid: Save both files in Overlook's config folder, /mnt/user/appdata/overlook unless you changed it on its form, named overlook.yaml and .env: from Unraid's terminal, the >_ at the top, such as with nano /mnt/user/appdata/overlook/overlook.yaml. Then restart Overlook on the Docker page. Once it's back, this page turns into the page.
setup.away: Overlook isn't answering. If it doesn't come back, its log says why.
setup.yaml.head: Overlook's config, from its setup page. Each source's README section says what else it takes.
